accident.inLog: In the accident log ({outcome}); the authority has not been told
accident.mustTellBody: Tell the market surveillance authority without delay through the Safety Business Gateway, then record the day here.
accident.noneBody: Record it when the report is about an accident, or someone was hurt.
accident.revisionsHint: Each revision is kept; the newest is the log's line.

common.discardBody: The report is not sent yet: closing now loses what you wrote.

dialog.checking: A quick check of this device first…

close.intro: Closing ends the assessment. The accident log and an erasure on request can still change later.
close.note: What quality found and what was done
close.title: Close the report

eraseInjury.intro: The words about the injury are blanked for good; when and by whom is kept.
eraseInjury.title: Erase the injury words

dialog.eraseLaw: Personal data is erased on the person's request.

eraseReporter.intro: The reporter's name, e-mail and phone are blanked for good. The report stays.
eraseReporter.title: Erase the reporter's data

facts.intro: The garment as the reporter gave it: ours are recognised again when you save.
facts.title: Correct the facts

file.intro: A new complaint entry opens in the PPE register for {style}, with the report's batch and serial.
file.noRight: Opening a register entry needs the right to manage the PPE register.
file.title: File in the PPE register
file.words: The entry names the report; it never copies the reporter's words or anything of an injury.

dialog.formIntro: This reaches the maker's quality team today. Fields marked as required are needed to look into it.
dialog.formIntroPortal: This reaches our quality team today, apart from returns and claims.
dialog.photosLater: You can add photos right after sending.
dialog.privacy: What you send is used only to look into this report, as the maker's privacy notice at the foot of the page says.
dialog.privacyPortal: What you send is used only to look into this report, as our privacy notice says.
dialog.reason: Whose request, and when it came

recordInjury.intro: Once recorded it never changes. The words only with the reporter's consent.
recordInjury.title: Record whether someone was hurt

dialog.reviewIntro: This is what will be sent.

revise.authorityHint: Fill in when the authority was told; leave empty otherwise.
revise.intro: A revision corrects or completes the log; the earlier ones stay.
revise.introFirst: The accident's first line in the log.
revise.introTold: Record the day the authority was told, and its reference.
revise.noteHint: Why this revision corrects or completes the log.
revise.referenceHint: For example the Safety Business Gateway's number.

dialog.sentBody: Our quality team reads it today. Thank you for telling us.
dialog.sentKeep: Keep the garment as it is: we may ask to see it.
dialog.sentNext: Quote the number if you write to the maker.
dialog.sentNextPortal: Quote the number if you write to us.
dialog.title: Report a problem

held.CLOSED: The report is closed: it changes no more (its accident log and an erasure on request still may).
held.ERASED: The injury words were erased on request already.
held.FILED: Filed in the PPE register already.
held.INJURY_RECORDED: The report says already whether someone was hurt: it never changes (an erasure blanks the words).
held.NOTHING_TO_ERASE: The report keeps none of the reporter's personal data.
held.NOT_FROM_HERE: The report cannot move that way.
held.NOT_SEEN: Quality has not seen it yet.
held.NO_INJURY: The report does not say whether someone was hurt.
held.NO_LOG: Recording in the accident log is for the product-safety role.
held.NO_MANAGE: Recording a report needs the right to manage product-safety reports.
held.NO_PERMISSION: Your role does not allow this: an admin grants it.
held.NO_SERVICE: A report opens a service case: you also need the right to manage service cases.
held.NO_STYLE: The report names no style: a register entry concerns one style, so correct the facts first.
held.NO_WORDS: There are no injury words to erase.
held.OFF: The doors from outside are closed until the privacy notice is published.
held.SEEN: Seen already (who saw it first is kept).
held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.
held.NO_INJURY_ROLE: Opening, recording or erasing the injury is for the product-safety role.
held.NO_MANAGE_ROLE: Changing a report needs the right to manage product-safety reports: an admin grants it.

intake.accident: It happened in an accident or a fall
intake.accidentHint: An accident, or anyone hurt, goes in the maker's accident log: the day and the place are then needed.
intake.batchHint: The batch number on the label (for example L-2231).
intake.consent: I agree that {keeper} keeps what I write about the injury, only to look into this report.
intake.consentLaw: Health data is kept only with an explicit consent.
intake.consentOffice: The reporter agreed that {keeper} keeps the words about the injury, only to look into this report.
intake.consentWhy: Injury details are health data: they are kept only with this consent, read only by the product-safety team, and erased on request.
intake.garmentHintBatch: The batch comes from the code you scanned. Add the serial if you find it on the label inside the garment.
intake.garmentHintOffice: The serial or the batch as the reporter gave them: ours are recognised when the report is saved.
intake.garmentHintOutside: Give the serial or the batch: both are on the label inside the garment.
intake.name: Name
intake.placeHint: One line: a road, a track, a town.
intake.reporterHint: Optional. Used only to ask about this report.
intake.reporterOfficeHint: As they gave themselves. Erased on request.
intake.serialHint: On the label inside the garment, under the barcode.
intake.whatHappenedHint: What happened to the garment, and when you noticed it. Please do not describe an injury here: there is a field for it below.
intake.whenWhereNeeded: Needed for an accident or an injury: they go in the accident log.

empty.body: Reports come from the public DoC page and the portal once their privacy notice is published; type one from a mail or a call meanwhile.
empty.title: No product-safety report yet

list.intro: Product-safety reports from the public DoC page, the portal, calls and mails. Each opens a service case; an accident goes in the accident log.
list.outsideClosedBody: They open once the privacy notice for these reports is published. Meanwhile type a report from a mail or a call here.
list.outsideClosedTitle: The public page and the portal take no reports yet
list.search: Search a number, serial, batch or style

tile.accidentsToTellHint: Serious harm or a death not told to the authority: opens the accident log
tile.notSeenHint: New reports quality has not opened

empty.body: A safety report about an accident, or anyone hurt, adds its line here.
empty.title: No accident recorded

log.intro: One line per accident a safety report recorded, as its newest revision says: the day, the place, the product and what came of it. The injury itself is never here.
log.law: Accidents with a product that caused a death or serious harm are told to the market surveillance authority without delay, through the Safety Business Gateway.
log.lawLine: The authority is told of an accident that caused a death or serious harm to health.
log.q37Body: Whether these duties reach PPE is the Owner's open question to the notified body: the accident log is kept either way.

tile.toTellHint: Serious harm or a death, not told yet

new.noCustomer: No customer (a rider or a reader)
new.partiesFailed: The customers could not be read: the report can be saved without one.
new.styleHint: When known; our serial or batch names it by itself.
new.stylesFailed: The styles could not be read: the serial or batch names it.
new.subtitle: From a mail, a call or a visit
new.title: New product-safety report

noAccess.body: You need the right to read product-safety reports. An admin grants it in the roles.
noAccess.title: Product-safety reports are not part of your access

photos.dialogIntro: Take a photo or choose one, then circle the problem if you like.

held.full: That is the most photos a report takes ({max}).
held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.
held.over: The time for photos is over: write to the maker to send more.

photos.intro: Photos of the garment and the damage help quality. Keep faces out of the picture.
photos.title: Photos

held.closed: Not open yet: our privacy notice for safety reports is not published. Meanwhile write to us with Ask a question.
held.failed: We could not check whether reports can be sent: reload the page.
held.noRequest: Your access lets you follow cases, not send them: ask your admin.
held.preview: An office preview cannot send reports.
held.reading: Checking whether reports can be sent…

portal.typeBody: Something about a garment that could hurt someone, or an accident: it reaches quality today, apart from returns.

problem.closeNote: Say what quality found and what was done.
problem.consent: Tick the consent first: the injury words are health data.
problem.email: An e-mail address such as name@example.com.
problem.injuryNotHurt: The injury is described only when someone was hurt.
problem.label: One line of at most 100 characters.
problem.name: One line of at most 200 characters.
problem.occurredOnNeeded: Say the day it happened: an accident goes in the accident log.
problem.phone: A phone number: digits, spaces and + ( ) . / - only.
problem.placeLine: One line of at most 300 characters.
problem.placeNeeded: Say where it happened: an accident goes in the accident log.
problem.reason: Say whose request it is and when it came.
problem.receivedFuture: A mail that came now or earlier.

revise.fields: Some fields need a look first.
revise.note: Say why this revision corrects or completes the log.
revise.occurredOn: Say the day of the accident.
revise.occurredOnLate: The accident happened on or before the day its report reached us, and not in the future.
revise.outcome: Say what came of it, coarsely.
revise.referenceAlone: A reference comes with the day the authority was told.
revise.toldBefore: The authority was told on or after the day of the accident.
revise.toldFuture: The authority was told today or earlier.
revise.toldOn: Say the day the authority was told.

problem.serialOrBatch: Give the serial or the batch from the garment's label.
problem.size: One line of at most 20 characters.
problem.whatHappened: Say what happened, and to the garment.

public.closedTitle: Reports cannot be sent from this page yet
public.closedWrite: The maker has not published its privacy notice for safety reports yet. Until then, write to {email} with the batch, the serial and what happened.
public.closedWriteNoMail: The maker has not published its privacy notice for safety reports yet. Until then, write to the maker at the address above.
public.failedBody: The rest of the page works. Try again in a moment.
public.failedTitle: We could not check whether reports can be sent here
public.heading: Report a problem
public.hint: For safety problems and accidents with this garment.
public.lead: Something wrong with this garment, or an accident while wearing it? Tell the maker: it reaches their quality team today.

read.failed: The reports could not be read. Try again.
read.forbidden: Your role does not open these reports.
read.network: No connection: the reports could not be read.

receipt.revised: The revision was recorded in the accident log.

record.changedBody: Read it again before you save: what you typed stays in the dialog.
record.fileHint: A new complaint entry for the report's style
record.injuryErased: The words were erased on request {when} by {who}
record.injuryNote: Health data, apart from the report
record.injuryRestricted: Only the product-safety role sees it.
record.injuryUnsaid: The report does not say whether someone was hurt.
record.injuryValue: Hurt, and the words about the injury
record.injuryWho: Only the product-safety role opens it; every opening is recorded
record.photosHint: Each opening is recorded. Faces stay out of the pictures.
record.reporterHidden: Only people who manage product-safety reports see the reporter.
record.reporterNone: Not given, or erased on request

refused.check: The quick device check did not pass. Try again in a moment.
refused.failed: It could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
refused.fields: Some fields need a look: they are marked below.
refused.forbidden: Your access lets you follow cases, not send them: ask your admin.
refused.forbiddenOffice: You need the right to record product-safety reports and to open service cases: an admin grants it.
refused.invalid: The report refused it as it is: check the fields.
refused.network: No connection: nothing was sent. Try again when you are back online.
refused.off: Reports cannot be sent here yet: the maker has not published its privacy notice for them.
refused.offPortal: Safety reports cannot be sent from the portal yet: our privacy notice for them is not published.
refused.photo: The photo could not be opened. Try again.
refused.stale: Someone changed the report meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
refused.unknownCode: This page's code is no longer known: check the code on the label.
refused.wait: Too many reports from this network: try again later.
refused.waitMinutes_one: Too many reports from this network: try again in {count} minute.
refused.waitMinutes_other: Too many reports from this network: try again in {count} minutes.
refused.waitSeconds_one: Too many reports from this network: try again in {count} second.
refused.waitSeconds_other: Too many reports from this network: try again in {count} seconds.

register.accidentLogHeld: Reading the accident log needs the right to read product-safety reports.

review.accident: In an accident or a fall
review.injuryDescribed: Described (read only by the product-safety team)

scan.intro: Point the camera at the code on the label: the serial fills in by itself.
scan.noCamera: No camera can be used here: type the serial instead.
